Team —

We need to lock the cadence and intake process for exemption requests related to the v1->v2 model cutover. Execs want a short note this week that summarizes who is impacted, what exceptions we’ll grant, and the comms schedule.

Asks:
- Can Marissa own the customer comms calendar and a single source doc? (I put a stub in Drive — link below)
- Ben, can you confirm what customer classes can be supported with a temporary routing shim (cost/latency tradeoffs) and what needs an actual exception?
- I’d like a first-pass exemption intake (spreadsheet) completed by EOD Wed so we can present to Product + Sales leadership on Thursday.

Context: the deprecation affects the inference-chat v1 endpoint (non-backward compatible change to tokenization + special tokens). We expect ~12 customers with potential breakage, and a second wave of ~30 that will need engineering coordination.

Attachments: I’ll attach the intake template (exemptions_intake_v1.xlsx).

Links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeFg-cutover-comms

Thanks —
Hannah

Marissa / Hannah —

On Mon, Oct 1, 2028 at 11:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Hannah — I can take calendar ownership. Plan suggestion...

Quick tech note / constraints:
- Routing shim (route incoming requests to a compatibility instance that does on-the-fly token translation) is feasible for a small set of customers only. The cost multiplier is ~2.4x and avg P95 latency increases by ~220ms.
- We can support up to 6 concurrent shim-enabled customers per dedicated pool before we need to open another reserve (capacity lead time ~72 hours).
- Exceptions that must be full rollouts (no shim) are: customers running fine-grained RLHF post-processing, or those using custom tokenizers (we can detect by token counts > expected baseline).

Suggested comms phrasing for shims: "We will provide a temporary compatibility proxy for select customers to reduce integration work. Expect slightly higher latency and a temporary cost adjustment."

Action items I’ll do by Tue EOD:
- Annotate intake rows with "shim-eligible / needs-engineering" and an estimated cost delta.
- Provide a short appendix for the 1-pager explaining the capacity implications and rollback process.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
